name: GeneratedTable
description: A table an assistant produced, shown as a real sortable table with a title and summary, numbers aligned, long results cut to a few rows, and a CSV download.

title.description: What the table shows. It is also the table's accessible name.

summary.description: One line under the title. Defaults to the row and column count.

maxRows.description: Rows shown before a Show all button. 0 shows every row.

isSortable.description: Let people sort by a column. Numbers sort by value, text in natural order.

onExport.description: Replaces the built-in CSV download, e.g. to save on the server.

keyboard: Enter / Space on a column header: sorts
Tab: moves to the Download and Show all buttons
requirements: A real table with a named header row and the first column as row header
Sort direction is exposed (aria-sort) and drawn with an arrow
Number columns are right-aligned and use tabular figures
The summary says how many rows are shown when the list is cut
CSV export prefixes cells starting with = + - or @ so a spreadsheet can't run them as formulas, and says when a file was downloaded
screenReader: Announced as a table named by the title, with its row and column count

use_when: Showing rows of data an assistant looked up or built
avoid_when: Thousands of rows or editing: use DataGrid
anti_patterns: Dumping a hundred rows with no limit
